title.en: Triples with Bitwise AND Equal To Zero

desc.zh: 保留有序数对的次数，再用子集求和统计兼容的第三个数。
desc.en: Preserve ordered-pair multiplicities, then sum compatible masks for each third value.

complexity: O(n² + B·2^B) time; O(2^B) auxiliary space, B = max(1, bit_length(max(nums))) ≤ 16

concepts.name: Ordered pair AND frequencies
concepts.description: Preserve repeated indices when grouping AND results.

concepts.name: Subset-sum transform
concepts.description: Partition masks by one bit to build compatible-pair totals.
